# Fixture: a brief that must pass. Every line carries an anchor.

## Product brief

- The instrument rail is 56px wide and never grows, because it is hardware rather
  than chrome: see `styles.css`.
- The reading column is 64ch, not 64rem, so a 12px caption gets the same physical
  line as 16px prose.
- Type is Archivo Narrow, chosen because the plate number has to fit a 56px rail.
- The colour field is Wada plate 002, Yellow Orange and Dark Tyrian Blue, and the
  hex values are the credited digital conversion in `data/colors.json`.
- Headings use a 1.25 ratio across 6 steps, so there are 6 sizes and no ad-hoc ones.
- The hero is the plate itself, full viewport, because the artefact is the printed
  colour relationship.

## Content

- 348 combinations, of which 3 are shown on the landing screen.
- "A colour can change the room. It cannot rescue an unclear task."
- The 2026-10-20 flood study covered 46 apps and labelled 31 by hand.
- The primary action is "Copy this for your agent", because that is what the
  visitor came for.
